story.value: The name protactinium comes from the Greek word protos, meaning first, because the element comes before actinium.
Kasimir Fajans and O.H. Göhring first identified protactinium in 1913 while studying uranium's decay chain.
Protactinium was first isolated by Aristid V. Grosse in 1934.

uses.value: Protactinium currently has no uses outside of basic scientific research.
There are currently no practical uses for protactinium other than basic scientific research.
